mechanism_claims.claim_text: FADDI-002 and FADDI-019 show stronger binding/displacement against purified bacterial LPS than polymyxin B or colistin in the dansyl-polymyxin displacement assay, supporting an LPS-binding mechanism context for the polymyxin lipopeptide series.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: FADDI-002 and FADDI-019 / polymyxin lipopeptide series
mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding values are mechanism support for LPS interaction, not proof of a unique molecular receptor; exact affinity rows are limited to Table S3 compounds and LPS sources.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FADDI-020 exposure increased NPN uptake into log-phase K. pneumoniae cells, supporting Gram-negative outer-membrane permeabilization as part of activity.
